narr: Heavy rain fell in northern and central New Jersey on the night of October 25-26. Rainfall totals were as high as 3 to 6 inches.
ev: A water rescue took place along Lawrence Avenue in North Plainfield. US Route 22 was closed at North Drive in North Plainfield due to flooding.
Several homes were evacuated in the borough of Middlesex due to flooding.
There were several road closures in Cranbury Township. The list includes Old Trenton Road at Ancil Davidson Road, Petty Road at the bridge over Cedar Brook, and Dey Road at Cedar Brook.
Mercer County Route 571 was closed between US Route 1 and Cranbury Road in West Windsor Township.
A section of Interstate 287 in Metuchen became impassable due to the heavy rain and flooding.
Oak Hill Road in Middletown Township was closed due to flooding.
There were numerous road closures in Union Beach, including Washington Avenue, Union Avenue, Florence Avenue, Central Avenue and NJ Route 36. Several water rescues were necessary.
A water rescue took place on NJ Route 35 at Holmdel Road in Hazlet.
NJ Route 35 was closed in Old Bridge Township between Laurence Parkway and Raritan Boulevard. Morristown Road was closed between NJ Route 34 and Disbrow Road in Old Bridge Township.
NJ Route 440 was closed near Pfeiffer Boulevard in Perth Amboy.
There were several road closures in Piscataway Township, including South Randolphville Road between Centennial Avenue and Sidney Road. Some homes were evacuated.
Riverside Drive was closed between Clawson Avenue and Mill Lane in Hillsborough Township due to flooding.
Three Bridges Road was closed between Hockenbury Road and Woodfern Road in Hillsborough Township.
New Market Avenue and Hamilton Boulevard in South Plainfield were closed due to flooding.
Lamington Road in Tewksbury Township was closed due to flooding.
There were several road closures in Readington Township, including a section of US Route 22 and Pleasant Run Road.
Several homes were evacuated in Dunellen due to flooding.
Minor flooding occurred along Middle Brook in the borough of Bound Brook.
Jersey Avenue was closed in North Brunswick Township and in New Brunswick due to flooding.
